name: Fullstack Delivery
description: 백엔드 API와 프론트엔드 SPA를 계약 기반으로 병렬 구현·통합 검증할 때. 기본: 백엔드(implement-complex), 프론트엔드(implement), Web QA(browser-qa). 선택: 통합 리뷰(deep-review).

roles.title: Backend Developer
checkpoints: Verify the API contract and run the focused backend tests.
roles.instructions: Implement the backend part of the task. Share the API contract, fixtures, and any migration constraints with frontend and web-qa.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
checkpoints: Run the frontend typecheck and test loading, error, and success behavior.
roles.instructions: Implement the UI against the agreed contract. Send web-qa the routes, prerequisites, and expected responses.

roles.title: Web QA
checkpoints: Verify a complete browser-to-API journey and its principal failure case.
roles.instructions: Use hc-team servers --run to find the app. Test the integrated flow, then report reproducible behavior and evidence.

roles.title: Integration Reviewer
checkpoints: Check compatibility and data integrity across the API boundary.
roles.instructions: Review the integrated change without editing files. Report material findings with source references and reproduction steps.
